text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: (…Wh— What do I do…!?)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(There's not much time until the 
exhibition… And I still don't have any 
ideas!)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
If I don't have anything by the big day, 
then…

text_block_list.name: Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
You hear about that one artist? Apparently 
she couldn't make the deadline!

text_block_list.name: Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
Man, I was looking forward to seeing her 
new piece… Guess it goes to show going 
viral doesn't count for much——

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: …N-No…! I can't let that happen…!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(…At the rate things are going, I'm going 
to mess things up for Love-chan, too…)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(…If I have to bother her either way… I 
should just talk to her at this point…)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Even if… I end up letting her down…

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
——Phew. That wasn't bad. I think that 
running might be able to get my love 
across.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(…If I remember correctly, she's supposed 
to be training here today…)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Um… Love, uh, chan…

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ! Maru-chan…

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
——Listen, I'm about to go all out! So keep 
your eyes on me, Maru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(——She's running forward, one step after 
another, without hesitation. It's like 
she's telling me… As long as I have love, 
there's nothing to fear.)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: (Her running is always… so…)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: ——Ah…

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: …So beautiful…

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
(So strong, just like back then… No, so 
much more than that. She's——)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Maru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What do you see? What mental picture am I 
making you paint!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: …Teehee. Well? How'd you like my running?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Um… You were, um, lovely. And… When you 
were running, you… You looked at me, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, that… Gave me the feeling that 
you were inviting me… I wonder why…

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
…Maybe you read my thoughts? You had a 
look on your face that was screaming "I 
wanna run"! In fact, you still do.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: …R-Really?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Say, Maru-chan. I don't blame you for 
wanting to make everyone happy. It shows 
how much love you've got to give. But——

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I don't think that's the only reason you 
work so hard.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's the other way around. Whatever you 
create… as long as you put your heart into 
it, I'm sure it'll make everyone happy.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
…… …Thank you, Love-chan. I… I figured out 
what I want to make.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
You're the reason I figured it out… So… 
are we… still a team? Can we keep pouring 
our hearts into this piece? …Together?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
! Of course we can! Let's pour our hearts 
into it—— And a whole lot of love!

Social media went abuzz at the opening of 
the exhibition. The center of attention 
was a small wood carving of an Umamusume, 
smiling with her hand outstretched.

It seemed as if merely touching her hand 
would make her take off running. Even a 
total stranger's heart would race when 
presented with such an incredible piece.
